bio:
ATLAS SkillTech University is India’s leading multidisciplinary University located in heart of the vibrant city of Mumbai. With a growing ambition to redefine the educational landscape of India by breaking conventional norms and embracing the progressive National Education Policy 2020,  our commitment spans across three modern streams: Design & Innovation, Management & Entrepreneurship, and Digital Technology. 

Through international collaborations, exceptional faculty, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and industry partnerships, we equip students for success in the dynamic Industry 4.0 era. Our Alumni thrive globally in top universities and elite corporate environments, collaborating on impactful solutions for today's challenges. 

Inspiring the next generation of trailblazers is at the heart of ATLAS SkillTech University.

Apply now and lead your way into the future!
